Marissa / team — reviewed VeloxAI's ask. Below are legal's recommended positions and a suggested compromise you can present back to the customer:

Summary of risk:
- Reducing the notice period from 60 -> 30 days shortens our ability to triage renewals and coordinate infra/ops cutovers. This increases operational risk and the chance of a late termination with outstanding invoices or data transfer work.
- Narrowing TFC support to "archived data only" without defining export/retention deliverables creates ambiguity and may lead to additional ad-hoc support requests.

Recommended commercial compromise:
- Offer a 45-day notice period instead of 30. Or accept 30 days if VeloxAI agrees to a one-time transition fee equal to one month of committed spend (applied to outstanding invoice or retained as transition compensation).
- Define TFC support as: (i) a one-time export of customer data in mutually agreed common formats; (ii) 30 days of limited, best-effort assistance for export verification; (iii) no obligation to perform bespoke migration or data transformation. Include a carve-out for any professional services requested (billable).

Suggested redline language (snippet you can paste into the OF/MSA):
"Termination for Convenience: Either party may terminate this Order Form upon providing [45] days' prior written notice to the other party. If Customer requests a shorter notice period of 30 days, Customer agrees to pay an early transition fee equal to one (1) month of fees at Customer's committed monthly spend.

Transition Support: Upon termination for convenience, Redwood will provide the following: (a) a one-time export of Customer data in CSV/JSON format for standard resource types; (b) thirty (30) days of limited, best-effort assistance to validate the export; (c) any additional migration or transformation services will be provided at Redwood's standard professional services rates. Redwood will not be required to provide live-system maintenance beyond the 30-day export assistance window."

Operational note: Karthik, if legal signs off on the above, please check that our billing and delivery teams can operationalize a 45-day window and a one-month fee if VeloxAI picks 30.

Happy to discuss any tweaks — I tried to balance commercial flexibility with clear limits on support scope.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
